    print(f"LEFT {i+1}: no_impact={r.get('no_impact')} done={r.get('done')} level_completed={r.get('level_completed')} reward={r.get('reward')} puck={puck(current_frame)}")
    if r.get('no_impact') or r.get('done') or r.get('level_completed'): break
